messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete for inference-api v2.14.0 (canary -> 100%). commit: a1b2c3d 12:05 UTC
Alex: heads-up — p95 spiking on inference-api us-west-2, started ~12:10
Alex: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference-api/p95-dashboard (looks like p95 jumped from ~400ms -> ~3.2s)
incident-bot: Paging on-call: @Sam
Sam: oncall here, looking
Alex: errors 500/timeouts increasing, 5xx rate x7 since 12:10, seeing 504s from gateway too
Maria: joining, what's the deploy? any canary? what changed?
deploy-bot: deploy metadata: v2.14.0, feature: multiplex-routing for short-seq KV reuse, canary ramped to 100% at 12:05
Maria: ok likely routing change. can we see gateway + runtime logs and p95/p99 timelines?
Alex: tail logs from gateway/runtime: 
```
[12:11:03] inference-api us-west-2 ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream=504 "POST /v1/generate" runtime_timeout
[12:11:04] runtime WARN kv-warmup delayed seq=16 key=xyz cache_miss=1
[12:11:05] runtime INFO multiplex: enqueue delay=320ms batch_size=1
```
Sam: that's customer-impacting. do we have blast radius? which tenants are hit?
Lee: quick triage — realtime-chat and internal playgrounds in us-west showing failures, approx 3-5% of total requests returning 5xx for a 12min window
Sam: recommend immediate rollback to v2.13.8 unless someone objects
Maria: I agree, v2.14.0 introduced routing change that can cause KV cache cold-paths under certain multiplex batching patterns; safe to rollback (no DB/schema changes)
Sam: rolling back now — initiating rollback to v2.13.8
deploy-bot: rollback started by Sam at 12:18 UTC, target: inference-api -> v2.13.8
Alex: quick smoke before/after — failing request example:
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood/inference \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' --max-time 6
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 12:12:08 GMT
Server: gateway
```
Sam: rollback in progress... toggling route traffic back to previous revision
incident-bot: Incident created: incident/2026-03-15T12:19Z - 'timeout regression after deploy' — Severity: P2
Maria: looking at runtime metrics — queuing latency in multiplex pool spiked (median enqueue delay up to 300ms), KV cache miss rate jumped, concurrent warmups causing head-of-line blocking
Sam: any mitigation short of rollback? we could split traffic away from v2.14.0 but rollback is fastest to restore SLOs
Sam: rollback complete — routing moved back to v2.13.8 at 12:22 UTC
deploy-bot: rollback complete. verified replicas at v2.13.8 and stable health checks
Alex: post-rollback metrics: p95 -> ~420ms, p99 -> ~250ms, 5xx rates back to baseline (~0.3%)
Lee: customer impact window approx 12:10-12:22 (~12 minutes). CS notified to bundle tickets and outreach
Chris: taking postmortem ownership and follow-up. I'll own the RCA and runbook updates
Maria: immediate action items: revert multiplex-routing opt-in, add KV warmup readiness probe to canary gating, add alert for kv-warmup latency > 200ms
Sam: oncall handoff — I'm handing to Chris for post-incident analysis; I'm available if needed
Sam: @Chris you're primary now until handoff
Chris: ack. plan: assemble timeline, reproduce locally with multiplex simulator, propose canary gating checks. will open the postmortem doc and link here
Alex: will add temporary dashboard panel for kv-warmup misses and enqueue delays
Lee: I'll prepare customer-facing summary and escalate any high-severity support tickets
Maria: also recommend adding a small ramp delay when toggling multiplex-routing so KV warmups can keep up
Sam: great. nice and fast rollback, blameless. we will follow up in the postmortem
Alex: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: oncall handoff: Sam -> Chris at 12:30 UTC
